externalEvidenceLimits: Provider responses and credentials are synthetic; no real OAuth or hosted availability claim.
Model setup exercises real worker progress, access refusal, retry and stop without accepting a multi-gigabyte artifact.
Updater checks and eligibility/failure gates are real; no host release payload is installed by browser tests.
The capability fallback alone injects live-session501; normal live tests forward real WebSocket frames and all canonical business APIs remain real.
